column1: # Scripted RNG tapes for PlaceGroup (monster.cpp:308-380 at devilutionX
# e1ad0c2b6). Each row's `script` is the exact GenerateRnd value sequence the
# call consumes: anchor rolls, then per iteration the PlaceMonster direction
# roll, the minion animation-frame roll (leader rows only) and the two scatter
# rolls of the for-loop increment. The tape is exhausted-checked: a call that
# draws more or fewer values than the row lists fails.
# The `want_tiles` entries are hand-derived from the upstream loop, one row per
# placed monster: x,y,direction,start_frame,max_hp,hit_points,intelligence,leashed
# with start_frame -1 for a monster whose AI keeps its animation. A build that
# "fixes" the vanilla `yp += deltaX` scatter (monster.cpp:341) lands elsewhere
# and fails, by design.
# Columns: case, world, num, active, total, leader(x,y|-), leashed, base_hp,
# base_int, base_frames, base_gargoyle, leader_int, script, want_tiles,
# want_rolls, want_rewinds, want_pack_size
# Worlds: open (0..63 placeable, one transparency region), blocked (same, but
# 17,18 unplaceable) and twotrans (0..63 placeable, dTransVal 0 for x<20, 1
# above).
open-no-leader
open-leashed
open-unleashed
blocked-no-leader
blocked-leashed
blocked-unleashed
twotrans-no-leader
